# FEMA activity fixtures

Recorded from public federal sources on 2026-11-16.

- `noaa_billion_dollar_events_1980_2024.csv`: NOAA NCEI Billion-Dollar Weather
  and Climate Disasters, the event list as served at
  `https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/access/billions/events-US-1980-2024.csv`,
  unmodified.
- `openfema_tropical_declarations_2023.json`: OpenFEMA
  `DisasterDeclarationsSummaries` for hurricanes, tropical storms and typhoons
  declared in 2023 (229 county designations), cut to the columns the loader
  reads.
